ukberi-tibyan:3-5.t:
Allah the Exalted said: (وَأَرْسَلَ عَلَيْهِمْ طَيْرًا أَبَابِيلَ (٣) تَرْمِيهِمْ بِحِجَارَةٍ مِنْ سِجِّيلٍ (٤) فَجَعَلَهُمْ كَعَصْفٍ مَأْكُولٍ (٥)).
The words of the Exalted (أَبَابِيلَ): it is said that it is a plural with no singular from its own root letters. It is also said that its singular is «إِبَّوْل», like «عِجَّوْل»; it is also said that its singular is «إِبِّيل»; and it is also said «إِبَّال». (تَرْمِيهِمْ) is a naʿt (adjective) of «طَيْر». The kāf is the second object. And Allah knows best. [Translator's note: the printed text vocalizes the second singular as «إِبَّيْل».]
